title: 📚 Classical Sanskrit Literature
description: Introduction to reading classical Sanskrit texts.

sections.title: 📖 Bhagavad Gita - Chapter 1, Verse 1
sections.content: Let's read the opening verse of the Bhagavad Gita, one of the most famous Sanskrit texts.

verse.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच — धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः। मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय।।
verse.transliteration: Dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca — dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ। māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva kimakurvata sañjaya।।
verse.translation: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, what did my sons and the Pandavas do when they assembled together on the sacred field of Kurukshetra, eager for battle?

sections.title: 📖 Ramayana - Valmiki's Opening
sections.content: Here is the opening verse of the Ramayana, the epic of Rama.

verse.sanskrit: तपःस्वाध्यायनिरतं तपस्वी वाग्विदां वरम्। नारदं परिपप्रच्छ वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवम्।।
verse.transliteration: Tapaḥsvādhyāyanirataṃ tapasvī vāgvidāṃ varam। Nāradaṃ paripapraccha Vālmīkir munipuṅgavam।।
verse.translation: The great sage Valmiki, who was devoted to penance and study, asked the great sage Narada, who was the best among those who know the truth and words.

questions.question: Who is speaking in the first verse of the Bhagavad Gita?
questions.explanation: Dhritarashtra speaks the first verse, asking Sanjaya what happened on the battlefield.

questions.question: What is the field called in the Bhagavad Gita's first verse?
Who asked the question in the Ramayana opening?
